title: Tech Note: Interaction between 4D 2003 and Microsoft Excel® (Web Services)

historical_commentary.text: The SOAP/WSDL-based server publication technique described here has been broadly superseded by REST/JSON APIs as the standard way to expose application data to Office and other clients, and modern Excel-to-4D integration would more likely use REST endpoints, Power Query, or direct database connectivity than a SOAP-published service.
related_updates: REST/JSON has broadly replaced SOAP as the preferred way to expose data from a server (including 4D) to Excel and other Office clients
